name: Improved Believer’s Channel
body:
Your channeling power has grown.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Believer’s Boon, Believer’s Channel, character level 11th, alignment must be within one step of your deity’s.

Benefit(s): Your ability to channel energy improves to that of a cleric of your character level – 4.

The Bardess’ Library #22: Virtues, © 2026, Legendary Games; Author: Margherita Tramontano.
